name: Date Calculator
description: Compute date differences, shift dates by days or months, and count working days in a range.

examples.label: Count working days in a week

hints.dateB: "Difference in days" and "Count working days" need the end date.
hints.days: "Add" and "Subtract" use this amount; negative values are accepted.
hints.unit: The unit decides whether the shift is counted in days or in calendar months and years.
hints.holidays: One `YYYY-MM-DD` per line; it only affects "Count working days" because no public holidays are built in.
hints.output: "Difference in days" counts calendar days and ignores the time of day.

faq.a: Yes. Both the start and the end day count towards working days; weekends and listed holidays do not.
No. The bundled snapshot only goes down to the province level, so list the holidays yourself in `YYYY-MM-DD` form.

faq.q: What happens when adding a month lands on a short month?
faq.a: The shift follows the calendar: `2024-01-31` plus one month gives `2024-02-29`, because February has no 31st.
